useCases: Digital human from one photo — a fixed presenter (face, outfit, voice description, prompt template) stored in `persona.json`, so every video
Lip-synced talking clips — the script is split into ≤ 15-second segments and generated with Grok Video 1.5 through Renoise MCP. Other models
Cost gate — the agent always quotes *segments · seconds · credits · balance* first and waits for your "yes". It generates segment 1 for you
readmeSummary: One photo + one sentence → a finished talking-head video with a digital human.
